risk: The decryption key was committed into Git history in the same transition as the encrypted artifact.
The bootstrap workflow also writes key material to a status object and step summary by design.
The currently stored ciphertext is the same artifact introduced by the exposure commit.
If the repository was public at any time while the commit was reachable, public exposure severity increases; historical visibility is not yet proven either way.
required_remediation: Rotate the TV/TVC-managed key through an authority-preserving secret channel.
Re-encrypt any payload that depended on the compromised key.
Remove all workflow behavior that writes, commits, prints, summarizes, or artifacts raw key material.
Preserve the historical commit as evidence; do not claim removal from current main erases Git history.
Resolve repository visibility on 2025-11-25 from organization audit-log evidence.
